topic: You should have come in sooner
title: You should have come in sooner
pt: Foco da aula: should have + particípio: conselhos médicos tardios

lines.en: Selma, your ankle looks awful. You should have come in sooner, and you shouldn't have walked on it all week.
lines.pt: Selma, seu tornozelo está horrível. Você devia ter vindo antes, e não devia ter andado nele a semana inteira.

lines.en: I know, I know. I thought it would heal on its own, so I just ignored the pain and kept working.
lines.pt: Eu sei, eu sei. Achei que ia curar sozinho, então simplesmente ignorei a dor e continuei trabalhando.

lines.en: That's a common mistake. Does the swelling get worse at night? Also, have you noticed any numbness in your toes?
lines.pt: É um erro comum. O inchaço piora à noite? E você notou alguma dormência nos dedos do pé?

lines.en: It's worse in the evening, yes, and my toes feel a little numb. I should have listened to you when you warned me last month.
lines.pt: Piora à noite, sim, e meus dedos estão meio dormentes. Eu devia ter te ouvido quando você me avisou no mês passado.

lines.en: We could have avoided all this swelling if you'd just rested. Anyway, I'll order an X-ray, and the nurse will book your appointment.
lines.pt: Teríamos evitado todo esse inchaço se você tivesse descansado. Enfim, vou pedir um raio-X, e a enfermeira vai marcar a sua consulta.

lines.en: Will I need surgery? I'm terrified, to be honest. My mother had it on her knee, and recovery took months.
lines.pt: Vou precisar de cirurgia? Estou apavorada, para ser sincera. Minha mãe fez no joelho, e a recuperação levou meses.

lines.en: Surgery is unlikely, but I'd rather examine it first. Are you allergic to any medication, like ibuprofen or penicillin?
lines.pt: Cirurgia é improvável, mas prefiro examinar primeiro. Você tem alergia a algum remédio, como ibuprofeno ou penicilina?

lines.en: Only to penicillin. I broke out in a rash as a child. Are you sure it isn't just a bad sprain?
lines.pt: Só a penicilina. Tive uma erupção na pele quando criança. Tem certeza de que não é só uma torção feia?

lines.en: I'm fairly sure, but the scan will tell us. Until then, keep it elevated, use ice, and stay home tomorrow.
lines.pt: Tenho quase certeza, mas o exame vai nos dizer. Até lá, mantenha elevado, use gelo e fique em casa amanhã.

lines.en: Okay, okay. I'll cancel my plans, lie on the couch, and finally finish the book on my shelf.
lines.pt: Tá bom, tá bom. Vou cancelar meus planos, ficar deitada no sofá e finalmente terminar o livro na minha estante.

lines.en: Good plan. Come back on Friday so we can check the swelling, and call me immediately if the pain gets worse.
lines.pt: Bom plano. Volte na sexta para vermos o inchaço, e me ligue imediatamente se a dor ficar pior.

facts.label: Conselho tarde demais
facts.sub: You should have come in sooner. I shouldn’t have ignored it. We could have avoided it. Sempre particípio depois de have.

facts.label: Deveria ter
facts.sub: Forme com should have + particípio: You should have called. Fala de uma ação que não aconteceu, mas era a melhor escolha. Na fala vira “shouldve”. Não use o passado simples depois de have.

facts.label: Não deveria ter
facts.sub: Para um erro feito: I shouldn’t have ignored the pain. Em português: “não deveria ter ignorado”. O particípio de go é gone, de come é come, de take é taken.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Should have + participle talks about the past.

items.why: We say You should have come.

items.s: Shouldn’t have means it was a mistake to do it.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Should have + participle talks about the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “You should have came”. → Falso (We say You should have come.)
Shouldn’t have means it was a mistake to do it. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Too late for the ankle · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy afternoon at a clinic in Manchester. Elsa works there as a nurse. Her friend Max limps into the waiting room. His ankle is red and swollen. He waited three days before coming. Elsa shakes her head kindly.

“Max, your ankle looks awful. You should have come in sooner, and you shouldn’t have walked on it.” says Elsa. “I know, I should have listened to you. I thought it would heal without any treatment.” says Max. “You should have called me on Sunday. We could have avoided all this swelling.” says Elsa.

pages.title: Too late for the ankle · 2/3
paragraphs: “You’re right. I shouldn’t have ignored the pain, and I should have put ice on it straight away.” says Max. “Exactly. And you shouldn’t have gone running yesterday. Did you take anything for the pain at least?” says Elsa. “Only a couple of tablets. I should have asked the pharmacist which ones were safe with my other medication.” says Max.

“That’s true. Someone at the surgery should have asked about your allergy, but you should have mentioned it as well.” says Elsa. “I should have written a list before the appointment. I always forget the details when I’m nervous.” says Max. “Next time, write everything down. For now, you should have an X-ray today, and you shouldn’t put any weight on it.” says Elsa.
